public_rationale: On Zitron’s stated 500-million base, the ceiling is 25 million weekly users. Google’s March figure, reported from court documents, was already 35 million daily Gemini users. For the same population, a week includes its daily users, so this establishes a weekly lower bound above the ceiling. The numerical premise is contradicted; this does not independently measure OpenAI’s share of the whole industry.
limitations: Uses reputable reporting of company evidence presented in court because the primary exhibit was not obtained.
The weekly figure is a lower bound, not a reported weekly total.
The March figures became public after the post; this assesses historical truth, not what Zitron could have known then.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI is effectively the entire generative AI industry; its nearest competitor has under 5% of its weekly active users.

statement.excerpt: OpenAI, as I've written before, is effectively the entire generative AI industry, with its nearest competitor being less than five percent of its 500 million weekly active users.
statement.document_title: OpenAI Is A Systemic Risk To The Tech Industry

from_speaker: effectively the entire generative AI industry
our_interpretation: The concrete test is whether the largest competing general-purpose generative AI assistant had fewer than 25 million weekly active users worldwide.
Gemini is an ordinary competitor within the stated industry-wide scope. Establishing that any competitor exceeded the ceiling is sufficient; identifying the largest is unnecessary.
Use March 2025, the latest complete calendar month before publication, for this ongoing observation.
The industry-dominance wording is assessed through its accompanying user-count assertion, not converted into a separate revenue or market-share claim.
A daily active-user count can establish a mathematical lower bound on weekly active users for the same population and corresponding week; it is not treated as an exact weekly count.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable worldwide weekly-user measurements show ChatGPT near 500 million and every competing assistant below 25 million during the target period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one competing assistant has 25 million or more weekly active users during the target period, established directly or by a valid same-population lower bound.
